title: Planned double-blind DNA test of the Peruvian bodies

tellings.quote: he's DNA testing it with these like independent aerospace contractors that and they're going to do some double blind stuff so no cheating allow.

plain: The bodies said to come from Peru, which are shown in a documentary called This Is Not a Hoax, were due to be DNA tested in 2025 by independent aerospace contractors, using a double-blind setup in which the testers do not know which sample is which, "so no cheating allowed." Michels mentions the plan in passing, naming Michael Mazzola and Jaime Maussan in connection with it, and does not say who the contractors are. If such a test went ahead, it would be an outside check on whether the bodies are what their promoters say they are.
